prompt_rules.text: Before a mutation, bind the request to the exact result model, target set, and authoritative value. Resolve a relative date or period from the task's current date or an explicit anchor, and propagate it to every date-derived field. For a scheduled or future email, use the operation and model that preserve scheduling, not an immediate send. For an 'already' or 'existing' constraint, evaluate the current records and do not create or download missing items to satisfy it. For a log entry that names an app metric, query that app's records for the requested period and compute the value before updating. For plural requests, enumerate the complete relevant collection once, including all relevant message folders, and map every member before mutating. When artifacts are in messages, inspect those messages rather than searching for the requester. Use the exact total or paid field when the request says total; use unit price only for item cost. Reuse verified facts, batch related reads, and skip extra discovery when the requested set and value are already verified. After mutation, verify the changed model and required fields.
